scope: Configurable Slidock home and verbatim official Slidev theme examples

officialThemesBrowserChecks: Five official samples appear under their own theme categories with real thumbnails and Slidock branding
Default: category filter, matching theme, first/last slide deep links and return home
Seriph: category filter, matching theme, first/last slide deep links and return home
Shibainu: category filter, matching theme, first/last slide deep links and return home
Bricks: category filter, matching theme, first/last slide deep links and return home
Apple Basic: category filter, matching theme, first/last slide deep links and return home
Mobile and tablet layouts fit the viewport
Keyboard skip link reaches the slide list
Empty catalog renders an empty state
customizationBrowserChecks: Entries preserve catalog and deck metadata
Default list, category filter, thumbnail, slide and return navigation work
Default mobile layout has no horizontal overflow
Broken catalog produces the default localized error
Framework-free custom entry and replacement stylesheet render
Custom deck navigation label and destination work
Custom Vue dependencies outside the entry directory avoid Slidev context injection
Home title, description, logo visibility, links, footer, category labels and CSS overrides work
Custom source, safe text, deck link override, unmount and typed mount/client errors work
Abort prevents late source completion from mounting
qualityGates.defaultHeroHidden: passed: official home and default mount have no hero; explicit hero:true works
qualityGates.heroRemovalRegression: pnpm check, official theme build/browser verification, customization browser verification passed

limitations: Official samples retain upstream external URLs. The legacy source.unsplash.com image endpoint returned HTTP 503; those images remain unavailable.
Native runtime and cloud deployment were not rerun; native fixture build and browser regression passed.
